messaging.label: Push and SMS delivery
messaging.description: Sends the SMS and push messages that were queued, within the toll-fraud caps.

messaging-inbound.label: Inbound SMS
messaging-inbound.description: Records a number opting out (STOP) or back in (START) from the SMS provider's webhook.

messaging-retention.label: Messaging retention
messaging-retention.description: Removes devices not seen for MESSAGING_DEVICE_RETENTION_DAYS and the toll-fraud counters of past days, every night.
